description: Returns ranked BUY SELL HOLD trade calls across the top crypto perpetual futures by open interest — one scan for whole-market coverage, each with confidence and market regime. Use this for breadth; use get_trade_call for per-coin depth and reasoning. Read-only: reads live exchange APIs, places no orders.

exchange.description: Crypto venue (default Binance), e.g. Binance Bybit OKX Bitget Hyperliquid.

includeHolds.description: Include HOLD calls after non-HOLD (default false).

includeReasoning.description: Enrich each non-HOLD call with price, the top 2-3 drivers, and one-line reasoning (default false → bare verdict cells). HOLDs stay bare. Same per-call detail as get_trade_call.

limit.description: Max ranked calls to return, 1 to 100 (default 10). Non-HOLD ranked first.

minConfidence.description: Optional confidence floor, 0 to 100, applied to non-HOLD trade calls.

minLiquidityUsd.description: Optional USD liquidity floor applied to the scan universe: notional open interest, or 24h volume on venues that expose no bulk OI. Omitted means no floor.

oiBasis.description: OI-delta basis for rankBy=oi_change: notional (default, USD) or contracts (base-coin, price-independent). Ignored by other lenses.

oiChangeWindow.description: OI-delta window for rankBy=oi_change: 1h, 4h, or 24h (default 24h). Ignored by other lenses.

rankBy.description: Universe lens: oi (default) volume gainers losers movers funding_positive funding_negative volatility oi_change (aliases vol gain lose move pfr nfr atr oid). funding_*/volatility/oi_change rank among the most-liquid perps; oi_change = real 24h open-interest %Δ.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe, 1m to 1d for the scan. Default 15m intraday.

topN.description: How many top perps by open interest to scan, 1 to 100 (default 20).

name: scan_trade_calls
